title.zh: 卷71 志四十六 地理十八 臺湾
title.raw: 卷71 志四十六 地理十八 臺湾

translations.literal: Treatise 46.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 46.

translations.literal: Geography 17.
translations.idiomatic: Geography 17.

translations.literal: Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 臺灣：古荒服之地，不通中國，名曰東番。

translations.literal: Taiwan: in antiquity a wild borderland, without contact with China; it was called the Eastern Barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan was anciently a remote borderland, cut off from China, and known as the Eastern Barbarians.

sentences.zh: 隋開皇中，遣虎賁陳棱略澎湖三十六島，

translations.literal: In the Kaihuang era of Sui, Huben Chen Ling was sent to subdue the thirty-six islands of Penghu.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaihuang reign of Sui, the Huben officer Chen Ling was dispatched to subdue the thirty-six islands of Penghu.

sentences.zh: 明嘉靖四十二年，海寇林道乾掠近海郡縣，都督俞大猷征之，追至澎湖，道乾遁入臺灣。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year of Jiajing of Ming, the sea bandit Lin Daoqian raided coastal prefectures and counties; Regional Commander Yu Dayou campaigned against him, pursued him to Penghu, and Lin fled into Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year of Jiajing (1563), the pirate Lin Daoqian raided coastal prefectures and counties; Regional Commander Yu Dayou campaigned against him, pursued him as far as Penghu, and Lin escaped into Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年，閩人顏思齊引日本國人據其地。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqi, the Fujian man Yan Siqi brought Japanese to occupy the place.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqi (1621), the Fujianese Yan Siqi brought Japanese settlers to take the island.

translations.literal: After a long time it was seized by the Dutch.
translations.idiomatic: In time the Dutch seized it.

sentences.zh: 清順治十八年，海寇鄭成功逐荷蘭人據之，偽置承天府，名曰東都，設二縣，曰天興，曰萬年。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi of Qing, the sea bandit Zheng Chenggong drove out the Dutch and seized it; he falsely set up Chengtian Prefecture, called it the Eastern Capital, and established two counties named Tianxing and Wannian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi (1661), the pirate Zheng Chenggong expelled the Dutch and held the island; he set up a rebel Chengtian Prefecture, styled it the Eastern Capital, and created two counties, Tianxing and Wannian.

sentences.zh: 其子鄭經改東都為東寧省，升二縣為州。

translations.literal: His son Zheng Jing changed the Eastern Capital to Dongning Province and promoted the two counties to prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zheng Jing renamed the Eastern Capital Dongning Province and elevated the two counties to prefecture rank.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十二年討平之，改置臺灣府，屬福建省，領縣三。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Kangxi it was pacified; Taiwan Prefecture was established, subordinate to Fujian Province, administering three counties.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 22 the island was pacified; Taiwan Prefecture was established under Fujian Province, with three counties under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，增置彰化縣，領縣四。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, Zhanghua County was added; four counties were administered.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 Zhanghua County was added, bringing the prefecture to four counties.

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu it was converted into a province.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 13 it was reorganized as a province.

sentences.zh: 光緒十三年九月庚午，閩浙總督楊昌濬、臺灣巡撫劉銘傳會奏，略云：「臺灣疆域，南北相距七百餘里，東西近者二百餘里，遠或三四百里，崇山大溪，鉤連高下。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, day gengwu, of the thirteenth year of Guangxu, Governors-General of Fujian and Zhejiang Yang Changjun and Taiwan Governor Liu Mingchuan jointly memorialized, stating in summary: "Taiwan's territory extends more than seven hundred li from north to south; from east to west it is about two hundred li in the nearer parts and three or four hundred li in the farther, with lofty mountains and great rivers interlinked in height and depth.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the ninth month of Guangxu 13, Yang Changjun, governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang, and Liu Mingchuan, governor of Taiwan, submitted a joint memorial in summary as follows: "Taiwan stretches more than seven hundred li from north to south; east to west it is about two hundred li in places and three or four hundred in others, with great mountains and rivers rising and falling in succession.

sentences.zh: 從前所治，不過山前迤南一線，故僅設三縣而有餘。

translations.literal: What was formerly governed was no more than the single line southward along the front of the mountains; therefore three counties alone sufficed.
translations.idiomatic: Former administration reached only the strip south of the central ranges, so three counties were once enough.

sentences.zh: 自後榛莽日開，故屢增庁治而猶不足。

translations.literal: Since then the wild thickets have daily been opened, and therefore subprefectures have repeatedly been added yet still prove insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: As the wilderness has steadily been opened, subprefectures have been added again and again, yet still fall short.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，沈葆楨請設臺北府、縣以固北路，又將同知移治卑南以顧後山，全臺官制，粗有規模。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu, Shen Baozhen requested establishment of Taipei Prefecture and county to secure the northern route, and also moved the subprefect to govern at Beinan to watch the rear mountains; the official system for all Taiwan had a rough framework.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 1 Shen Baozhen proposed Taipei Prefecture and county to secure the north, and moved a subprefect's seat to Beinan to oversee the eastern ranges; Taiwan's administrative framework then took rough shape.

sentences.zh: 然彼時局勢，未聞擇要修舉，非一勞永逸之計也。

translations.literal: Yet the situation at that time did not hear of choosing essentials and carrying out thorough reforms; it was not a plan to settle matters once for all.
translations.idiomatic: But under conditions then prevailing, no comprehensive reforms were undertaken; that was no lasting settlement.

sentences.zh: 臣等公同商酌，竊謂建置之法，恃險與勢，分治之道，貴持其平。

translations.literal: Your ministers jointly deliberated and venture to say that in methods of establishment one relies on terrain and strategic position, while in the way of divided governance what is prized is maintaining balance.
translations.idiomatic: We have deliberated together and hold that administrative design should exploit terrain and strategic advantage, while divided rule must keep jurisdictions in balance.

sentences.zh: 臺省治理，視內地為難，而各縣幅員，反較多於內地。

translations.literal: Governing Taiwan Province is harder than the interior, yet each county's area is on the contrary larger than in the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan is harder to govern than the mainland, yet its counties are larger than most inland ones.

sentences.zh: 如彰化、嘉義、鳳山、新竹、淡水等縣，縱橫二百餘里、三百里不等，倉卒有事，鞭長莫及。

translations.literal: Such counties as Zhanghua, Jiayi, Fengshan, Xinzhu, and Danshui extend two hundred-odd to three hundred li in length and breadth; if something arises in haste, the whip cannot reach.
translations.idiomatic: Counties such as Zhanghua, Jiayi, Fengshan, Xinzhu, and Danshui span two to three hundred li; in a sudden crisis officials cannot reach the scene in time.

sentences.zh: 且防務為治臺要領，轄境太廣，則耳目難周，控制太寬，則聲氣多阻。

translations.literal: Moreover defense is the essential point in governing Taiwan; if jurisdiction is too broad, eyes and ears cannot cover it; if control is too loose, communications are often blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Defense is the heart of governing Taiwan: too broad a jurisdiction leaves officials blind, while too loose control blocks timely communication.

sentences.zh: 至山後中、北兩路，延袤三四百里，僅區段所設碉堡，並無專駐治理之員，前寄清虛，亦難遙制。

translations.literal: As for the central and northern routes behind the mountains, stretching three or four hundred li, only blockhouses were set up by sections, with no officials stationed solely to govern; formerly entrusted to empty oversight, they were also hard to control from afar.
translations.idiomatic: The central and northern routes behind the mountains stretch three or four hundred li, with only scattered blockhouses and no dedicated administrators; left effectively ungoverned, they could not be controlled from afar.

sentences.zh: 現當改設伊始，百廢俱興，若不量予變通，何以定責成而垂久遠？

translations.literal: Now at the beginning of reorganization, a hundred neglected tasks all arise; if we do not measure out adaptations, how can we fix responsibility and extend it far?
translations.idiomatic: With reorganization just beginning and every institution to be revived, without measured reform how can duties be fixed for the long term?

sentences.zh: 臣銘傳於上年九月親赴中路督剿叛番，沿途察看地勢，並據各地方官，將境內扼塞道里、田園山溪，繪圖貼說，呈送前來。

translations.literal: Your minister Mingchuan in the ninth month of last year personally went to the central route to supervise suppression of rebellious aborigines, inspected terrain along the way, and on the basis of local officials had strategic passes, roads and distances, fields, gardens, mountains, and streams within the borders mapped with explanatory notes and presented.
translations.idiomatic: Last ninth month your minister Liu Mingchuan personally led the campaign on the central route against rebel tribes, inspected the terrain, and had local officials map strategic points, roads, farmland, and waterways with explanatory notes, which were submitted.

sentences.zh: 又據撫番清賦各員弁將撫墾地所陸續稟報，謹就山前後通局籌畫，有應添設者，有應改設者，有應裁撤者。

translations.literal: Again on reports successively submitted by officers pacifying aborigines and clearing land taxes on reclaimed fields, we respectfully plan for the whole situation before and behind the mountains: some offices should be added, some changed, some abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Reports from officers pacifying tribes and registering reclaimed land have also been received; considering the whole island, we propose additions, changes, and abolitions of offices as needed.

sentences.zh: 查彰化橋孜圖地方，山環水複，中開平原，氣象宏敞，又當全臺適中之地，擬照前撫臣岑毓英議，就該處建立省城，分彰化東北之境設首府曰臺灣府，附郭首縣曰臺灣縣，將原有之臺灣府、縣改為臺南府安平縣。

translations.literal: Investigating the place Qiaozitu in Zhanghua, mountains surround it and waters encircle it; a plain opens in the center with a grand aspect, and it lies moreover at the central point of all Taiwan; we propose following the former governor Cen Yuying's plan to establish the provincial capital there, divide the northeastern part of Zhanghua to set a capital prefecture called Taiwan Prefecture, with the attached capital county called Taiwan County, and change the original Taiwan Prefecture and county to Tainan Prefecture and Anping County.
translations.idiomatic: At Qiaozitu in Zhanghua, ringed by mountains and water, a broad plain opens at the island's geographic center; following former Governor Cen Yuying's proposal, we would place the provincial capital there, carve northeastern Zhanghua into a new Taiwan Prefecture with seat-attached Taiwan County, and rename the old Taiwan Prefecture and county as Tainan Prefecture and Anping County.

sentences.zh: 嘉義之東，彰化之南，自濁水溪至姑石圭溪止，截長補短，方長四百餘里，擬添設一縣曰云林縣。

translations.literal: East of Jiayi and south of Zhanghua, from the Zhuoshui River to the Gushigui River, cutting long and patching short, the square measure is more than four hundred li; we propose adding one county called Yunlin County.
translations.idiomatic: Between Jiayi to the east and Zhanghua to the south, from the Zhuoshui River to the Gushigui River—a district of roughly four hundred li—we propose a new Yunlin County.

sentences.zh: 新竹苗栗街一帶，扼內山之衝，東連大湖，沿山新墾荒地甚多，擬於新竹西南各境添設一縣曰苗栗縣，合原有之彰化，及埔里社通判，一庁、四縣，均隸臺灣府屬。

translations.literal: The belt of Miaoli Street in Xinzhu commands the pass of the inner mountains, links east to Dahu, and has much newly reclaimed wasteland along the mountains; we propose adding one county called Miaoli County in the southwestern districts of Xinzhu; together with the original Zhanghua and the Puli subprefect, one subprefecture and four counties would all be subordinate to Taiwan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Miaoli area in Xinzhu commands the inner mountain passes, links east to Dahu, and has extensive new reclamation along the slopes; we propose Miaoli County in southwestern Xinzhu. With Zhanghua and the Puli subprefect, one subprefecture and four counties would fall under Taiwan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其鹿港同知一缺，應即裁撤。

translations.literal: The one post of Lukang subprefect should be abolished at once.
translations.idiomatic: The Lukang subprefect post should be abolished.

sentences.zh: 淡水之北，東控三貂嶺，番社歧出，距縣太遠。

translations.literal: North of Danshui, controlling east the Sandiao Ridge, aboriginal villages branch out and lie too far from the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: North of Danshui, east toward Sandiao Ridge, aboriginal settlements branch off too far from the county seat for effective rule.

sentences.zh: 基隆為臺北第一門戶，通商建埠，交涉紛繁，現值開採煤礦，修造鐵路，商民麕集，尤賴撫綏。

translations.literal: Keelung is Taipei's foremost gateway; treaty ports were opened and negotiations are numerous; now coal is being mined and railways built, merchants and people gather in crowds, and pacification is especially relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: Keelung is Taipei's principal gateway: a treaty port with constant foreign dealings, now coal mining and railways drawing dense settlement, all requiring firm administration.

sentences.zh: 擬分淡水東北四堡之地，撤歸基隆庁管轄，將原設通判改為撫民理番同知，以重事權。

translations.literal: We propose dividing the four forts northeast of Danshui and returning them to Keelung subprefecture's jurisdiction, changing the former subprefect to a subprefect pacifying the people and managing aborigines, to strengthen authority.
translations.idiomatic: We propose transferring four districts northeast of Danshui to Keelung subprefecture and elevating the subprefect to a pacification-and-aborigine-affairs post with broader authority.

translations.literal: This is the general outline of additions and changes on the front route.
translations.idiomatic: Such is the outline of reforms for the western districts.

sentences.zh: 後山形勢，北以蘇溪為總隘，南以卑南為要區，控扼中權，厥惟水尾。

translations.literal: The terrain behind the mountains: in the north Suxi is the chief pass, in the south Beinan is the vital zone; to control the central pivot, none but Shuiwei.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the mountains, Suxi guards the northern pass and Beinan the southern key; Shuiwei holds the strategic center.

sentences.zh: 其地與擬設之雲林縣東西相直，現開路百九十餘里，由丹社嶺集集街經達彰化，將去省城，建立中路，前後脈絡，呼吸相通，實為臺東鎖鑰。

translations.literal: That place lies directly east-west with the proposed Yunlin County; a road of more than one hundred ninety li is now opened from Danshe Ridge and Jiji Street through to Zhanghua, approaching the provincial capital; establishing the central route, front and rear linked, breath communicating—it is truly the lock and key of eastern Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: It lies due east of the proposed Yunlin County; a road of more than one hundred ninety li now runs from Danshe Ridge and Jiji to Zhanghua and the future provincial capital, linking east and west—the strategic key to eastern Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 擬添設直隸州知州一員曰臺東直隸州，左界宜蘭，右界恆春，計長五百餘里，寬約四十里、十餘里不等，統歸該州管轄，仍隸於臺灣兵備道。

translations.literal: We propose adding one directly subordinate prefecture magistrate for Taitung Directly Subordinate Prefecture, bounded on the left by Yilan and on the right by Hengchun, totaling more than five hundred li in length and about forty or more than ten li in width, all under that prefecture's jurisdiction, still subordinate to the Taiwan military defense circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: We propose Taitung Directly Subordinate Prefecture, bounded by Yilan on the west and Hengchun on the east—over five hundred li long and ten to forty li wide—still under the Taiwan military intendant.

sentences.zh: 其卑南庁舊治，擬請改設直隸州同一員。

translations.literal: Its old Beinan subprefecture seat is proposed to be changed to one directly subordinate prefecture subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: The former Beinan subprefecture seat would become a directly subordinate prefectural subprefect.

sentences.zh: 水尾迤南，改為花蓮港庁。

translations.literal: Southward from Shuiwei, it is changed to Hualian Harbor subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: South of Shuiwei would become Hualian Harbor subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 其內已墾熟田約數千畝。

translations.literal: Within it there are already reclaimed mature fields of about several thousand mu.
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand mu of land there are already under cultivation.

sentences.zh: 其外海口水深數丈，稽查商舶，彈壓民番，擬請添設直隸州判一員，常川駐紮，均隸臺東直隸州屬。

translations.literal: Outside, the estuary is several zhang deep; inspecting merchant vessels and restraining settlers and aborigines, we propose adding one directly subordinate prefecture judge permanently stationed, all subordinate to Taitung Directly Subordinate Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The outer harbor is several zhang deep; to inspect shipping and keep settlers and tribes in order, we propose a permanently stationed directly subordinate prefectural judge under Taitung Prefecture.

translations.literal: This is the general outline of additions behind the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Such is the outline of reforms for the eastern districts.

sentences.zh: 謹按臺灣疆土賦役，日增月廣，與舊時羈縻僑置情形迥不相同，因地制宜，似難再緩。

translations.literal: Respectfully considering Taiwan's territory and taxes and corvée, they increase daily and expand monthly, utterly unlike the former situation of loose control and nominal placement; adapting measures to local conditions seems hard to delay further.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan's territory and tax base have grown steadily, far beyond the old era of nominal control; local adaptation can hardly be postponed.

sentences.zh: 況年來生番歸化，狉榛之性初就範圍，尤須分道拊循，藉收實效。

translations.literal: Moreover in recent years raw aborigines have submitted; their wild and uncouth nature is first brought within bounds, and it is especially necessary to pacify them by separate routes to gather real effect.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, as raw tribes have lately submitted and their wild ways are first being brought under discipline, separate routes of pacification are needed to secure lasting results.

sentences.zh: 輯遐牖邇，在在需員，臣等身在局中，既不敢遇事紛更，以紊典章之舊，亦不敢因陋就簡，以失富庶之基，損益酌中，期歸妥協。」

translations.literal: Gathering the distant and enlightening the near, everywhere officials are needed; your ministers are within the situation and dare not on every matter make confused changes to disorder the old statutes, nor dare we follow the crude and choose the simple, losing the foundation of wealth and population; weighing increase and decrease and striking the middle, we hope to reach a proper settlement."
translations.idiomatic: Bringing distant peoples near requires officials everywhere; we dare neither change institutions recklessly nor settle for makeshift rule that would forfeit prosperity—we seek a balanced and workable settlement."

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year it was ceded and placed under Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year [of Guangxu] it was ceded to Japan.

sentences.zh: 省在福建東南五百四十里。

translations.literal: The province lies five hundred forty li southeast of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: The province lies five hundred forty li southeast of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 西北距京師七千二百五十里。

translations.literal: Northwest it is seven thousand two hundred fifty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lies seven thousand two hundred fifty li northwest of the capital.

translations.literal: On the east it borders the sea;
translations.idiomatic: East: the sea;

translations.literal: on the west it borders Penghu Island;
translations.idiomatic: west: Penghu Island;

translations.literal: on the south it borders Jitou Sea;
translations.idiomatic: south: Jitou Sea;

translations.literal: on the north it borders Keelung City Sea.
translations.idiomatic: north: the sea off Keelung.

sentences.zh: 廣五百里，袤一千八百里。

translations.literal: It is five hundred li wide and one thousand eight hundred li long.
translations.idiomatic: It measures five hundred li across and one thousand eight hundred li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 一統志載戶口原額人丁一萬八千八百二十七，滋生男婦大小口共一百七十八萬六千八百八十三，戶二十二萬四千六百四十六。

translations.literal: The Comprehensive Gazetteer records the original registered population of 18,827 adult males, with registered growth of males, females, and persons of all ages totaling 1,786,883, and 224,646 households.
translations.idiomatic: The Comprehensive Gazetteer records an original quota of 18,827 adult males, with registered growth bringing the total population to 1,786,883 persons in 224,646 households.

sentences.zh: 領府三，州一，庁三，縣十一。

translations.literal: It administered three prefectures, one department, three subprefectures, and eleven counties.
translations.idiomatic: It comprised three prefectures, one department, three subprefectures, and eleven counties.

sentences.zh: 臺灣屹峙海中，為東南屏障，四面環海，崇山峻岭，橫截其中，背負崇岡，襟帶列島。

translations.literal: Taiwan stands towering in the sea as the southeastern screen; on all four sides it is encircled by sea; lofty mountains and steep ridges cut across its midst; it backs onto high hills and clasps a chain of islands at its breast.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan rises from the sea as the southeastern rampart of the empire, ringed by water, with lofty ranges running through its center, highlands at its back, and archipelagos at its flanks.

sentences.zh: 浪嶠南屏，雞籠北衛，澎湖為門戶，鹿耳為咽喉。

translations.literal: Langjiao is the southern screen, Jilong the northern guard; Penghu is the gateway, Luer the throat.
translations.idiomatic: Langjiao screens the south and Jilong guards the north; Penghu is its gateway and Luer its throat.

sentences.zh: 七鯤身毗連環護，三茅港匯聚澄泓。

translations.literal: The Seven Kun bodies adjoin in linked protection; Sanmao Harbor gathers clear deep waters.
translations.idiomatic: The Seven Kun islets form a protective chain, and Sanmao Harbor gathers clear, deep waters.

translations.literal: Its abundance in livestock is no different from the central lands.
translations.idiomatic: Its livestock are as abundant as on the mainland.

translations.literal: Truly it is a great metropolis of the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: It is truly a great metropolis of the southeast.

translations.literal: Taiwan Prefecture: rated strategically critical, administratively busy, fiscally strained, and geographically difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan Prefecture: designated as strategically critical, administratively busy, fiscally strained, and geographically difficult.

translations.literal: It was the seat of Taiwan Province.
translations.idiomatic: It served as the provincial capital of Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 巡撫、布政使、分巡兵備道兼按察使銜，共駐。

translations.literal: The governor, provincial administration commissioner, and circuit intendant for military defense and inspection with additional surveillance commissioner title were all stationed together.
translations.idiomatic: The governor, provincial administration commissioner, and the military-defense circuit intendant (also holding surveillance commissioner rank) were all stationed there.

sentences.zh: 其地東及東南界臺東州；

translations.literal: Its territory on the east and southeast bordered Taitung Department;
translations.idiomatic: East and southeast: Taitung Department;

translations.literal: on the west and north it bordered the sea;
translations.idiomatic: west and north: the sea;

translations.literal: on the south and southwest it bordered Tainan Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: south and southwest: Tainan Prefecture;

translations.literal: on the northeast it bordered Taipei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: northeast: Taipei Prefecture.

translations.literal: The figures for width and length in li are missing.
translations.idiomatic: Its dimensions in li are not recorded.

sentences.zh: 北極高二十四度三十三分。

translations.literal: North polar altitude: twenty-four degrees thirty-three minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude is 24°33′ north.

translations.literal: East of the capital by four degrees twenty minutes.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 4°20′ east of the capital meridian.

translations.literal: It administered four counties and one subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It administered four counties and one subprefecture.

translations.literal: Taiwan [County]: rated strategically critical, administratively busy, fiscally strained, and geographically difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan County: designated as strategically critical, administratively busy, fiscally strained, and geographically difficult.

translations.literal: Attached [to the prefectural seat].
translations.idiomatic: Its seat adjoined that of the prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: Mountains within the prefecture: in the northwest, Wuhe and Niukun Mountains.

translations.idiomatic: West: Laolao Mountain.

sentences.zh: 南：蘆芝、芎根、郡坑、松柏山、土山。

translations.literal: South: Luzhi, Qionggen, Junkeng, Songbai, and Tushan Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: South: Luzhi, Qionggen, Junkeng, Songbai, and Tushan Mountains.

translations.idiomatic: East: the inner mountain range.

sentences.zh: 濁水出埔里社庁東南山，西南流，左合二水，經雲林縣東北，一水自南來注之。

translations.literal: The Zhuoshui issued from the southeast mountains of Puli subprefecture and flowed southwest; on the left it joined two streams, passed the northeast of Yunlin County, and one stream came from the south to enter it.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhuoshui rose in the southeastern mountains of Puli subprefecture and flowed southwest, receiving two streams on the left; passing northeast of Yunlin County, it was joined by a stream from the south.

translations.literal: It bent north, received one stream on the right, and passed north of the county.
translations.idiomatic: It turned north, received a stream on the right, and passed north of the county seat.

sentences.zh: 又西北，一水自嘉義縣來，北流注之。

translations.literal: Again northwest, one stream came from Jiayi County and flowed north to enter it.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest, a stream from Jiayi County flowed north to join it.

sentences.zh: 又西經牛埔厝，歧為三支：一支曰石龜溪，西為牛椆溪；

translations.literal: Again west it passed Niupucuo and divided into three branches: one branch called Shigui Stream, west becoming Niuchou Stream;
translations.idiomatic: Farther west it passed Niupucuo and split into three branches: one, the Shigui Stream, became the Niuchou Stream to the west;

sentences.zh: 一支曰虎尾溪，經汕頭厝為麥藔港，並經縣西入于海；

translations.literal: one branch called Huwei Stream, passing Shantoucuo as Mailiao Harbor, both passing west of the county to enter the sea;
translations.idiomatic: one, the Huwei Stream, passed Shantoucuo as Mailiao Harbor, and both entered the sea west of the county;

sentences.zh: 一支為東螺溪，又歧為三，曰刺桐港即番挖港，曰鹿港，曰二林港，並經彰化縣西入于海。

translations.literal: one branch was the Dongluo Stream, which again divided into three, called Citong Harbor (that is, Fanwa Harbor), Lukang Harbor, and Erlin Harbor, all passing west of Zhanghua County to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: one was the Dongluo Stream, which split again into three mouths—Citong (Fanwa) Harbor, Lukang Harbor, and Erlin Harbor—all entering the sea west of Zhanghua County.

sentences.zh: 大肚溪上源曰合水溪，出埔里社庁東南魚池仔，西北流，合南硿溪，經庁西北，北港溪、北硿溪並西流注之。

translations.literal: The upper source of the Dadu River is called the Heshui Stream, issuing from Yuchizi southeast of Puli subprefecture, flowing northwest, joining the Nankeng Stream, passing northwest of the subprefecture; the Beigang and Beikeng streams both flowed west to enter it.
translations.idiomatic: The Dadu River's upper course, the Heshui Stream, rose at Yuchizi southeast of Puli subprefecture and flowed northwest, merging with the Nankeng Stream; passing northwest of the subprefecture, it received the Beigang and Beikeng streams from the west.

sentences.zh: 又西，珠子山二水合西北流注之，經府治南，左右各納一水，經大肚街為大肚溪，又西北入于海。

translations.literal: Again west, two streams from Zhuzi Mountain joined and flowed northwest to enter it; passing south of the prefectural seat, it received one stream on each side, passed Dadu Street as the Dadu River, and again northwest entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west, two streams from Zhuzi Mountain merged and flowed northwest to join it; passing south of the prefectural seat and receiving streams on both sides, it became the Dadu River at Dadu Street and entered the sea to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 大甲溪出苗栗縣東南，合數小水，西南流，右出支津注於吞霄溪。

translations.literal: The Dajia River issued from the southeast of Miaoli County, joined several small streams, and flowed southwest; on the right a branch channel issued to enter the Tunxiao Stream.
translations.idiomatic: The Dajia River rose southeast of Miaoli County, gathered several tributaries, and flowed southwest; a branch on the right fed the Tunxiao Stream.

sentences.zh: 正渠南流，左納一水，折西北，經鐵砧山南，又西北入于海。

translations.literal: The main channel flowed south, received one stream on the left, turned northwest, passed south of Tiezhen Mountain, and again northwest entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The main channel flowed south, received a stream on the left, turned northwest past Tiezhen Mountain, and entered the sea.

sentences.zh: 吞霄溪出苗栗縣東南，合大甲溪支津，經縣南，西北流入于海。

translations.literal: The Tunxiao Stream issued from the southeast of Miaoli County, joined the branch channel of the Dajia River, passed south of the county, and flowed northwest to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Tunxiao Stream rose southeast of Miaoli County, received the Dajia River's branch, passed south of the county seat, and flowed northwest into the sea.

sentences.zh: 後壠溪出苗栗縣東南山，合一水，西北流，經五鶴山，南至鋼羅灣，夾二洲，又西北，經縣治北，右通中港溪，左納一水，入于海。

translations.literal: The Houlong Stream issued from the southeast mountains of Miaoli County, joined one stream, flowed northwest, passed Wuhe Mountain, south to Gangluo Bay with two islets between, again northwest, passed north of the county seat, on the right connected with the Zhonggang Stream, on the left received one stream, and entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Houlong Stream rose in the southeastern hills of Miaoli County, gathered a tributary, and flowed northwest past Wuhe Mountain to Gangluo Bay, where two sandbars flanked its course; turning northwest past the county seat, it linked on the right with the Zhonggang Stream, received a stream on the left, and entered the sea.

sentences.zh: 中港溪出縣東山，緣界西北流，經縣治，左出支津合後壠港支水為烏眉溪，與正渠並西北入于海。

translations.literal: The Zhonggang Stream issued from the eastern mountains of the county, followed the border and flowed northwest, passed the county seat, on the left a branch channel issued to join the branch water of Houlong Harbor as the Wumei Stream, and together with the main channel northwest entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhonggang Stream rose in the county's eastern hills, followed the border northwest past the county seat; a branch on the left joined the Houlong Harbor branch to form the Wumei Stream, and both entered the sea with the main channel.

translations.idiomatic: Mountains within the prefecture: in the north, Taihu, Baishui, and Mugang Mountains.

sentences.zh: 牛椆溪出嘉義縣東，西北流，經治北，與布袋嘴港並西流入于海。

translations.literal: The Niuchou Stream issued from the east of Jiayi County, flowed northwest, passed north of the seat, and together with Buduizui Harbor west entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Niuchou Stream rose east of Jiayi County, flowed northwest past the county seat, and with Buduizui Harbor entered the sea to the west.

sentences.zh: 八掌溪出雲林縣界，西北流，經平鼻山北半月山，南合瀵箕湖及一小水，西流至鹽水港，入于海。

translations.literal: The Bazhang Stream issued from the border of Yunlin County, flowed northwest, passed north of Pingbi Mountain and Banyue Mountain, south joined Fenji Lake and one small stream, flowed west to Yanshui Harbor, and entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Bazhang Stream rose on the Yunlin border, flowed northwest past Pingbi and Banyue mountains, gathered Fenji Lake and a tributary from the south, and entered the sea at Yanshui Harbor.

sentences.zh: 急水溪二源，並出雲林縣西界，經嘉義縣東南，合西流，又經急水鋪南，左納十八重溪，又經鐵線橋街北，又西入于海。

translations.literal: The Jishui Stream had two sources, both issuing from the western border of Yunlin County, passing the southeast of Jiayi County, joining and flowing west, again passing south of Jishui Post, on the left receiving the Shibazhong Stream, again passing north of Tiexianqiao Street, and again west entering the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Jishui Stream rose in two branches on Yunlin's western border, merged southeast of Jiayi County, flowed west past Jishui Post, received the Shibazhong Stream on the left, passed north of Tiexianqiao Street, and entered the sea.

sentences.zh: 曾文溪出府治東北，西北流，經大武壠北，右納茄拔溪，左納一小水，經府治北，又西經倒風港，入于海。

translations.literal: The Zengwen Stream issued from the northeast of the prefectural seat, flowed northwest, passed north of Dawulao, on the right received the Qieba Stream, on the left received one small stream, passed north of the prefectural seat, again west passed Daofeng Harbor, and entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Zengwen Stream rose northeast of the prefectural seat, flowed northwest past Dawulao, received the Qieba Stream on the right and a tributary on the left, passed north of the seat, and entered the sea at Daofeng Harbor.

sentences.zh: 柴頭港出府治東北山，西北流，經治北，又西合德慶港為安平港，入于海。

translations.literal: The Chaitou Harbor issued from the northeastern mountains of the prefectural seat, flowed northwest, passed north of the seat, again west joined Deqing Harbor as Anping Harbor, and entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Chaitou Harbor rose in the hills northeast of the prefectural seat, flowed northwest past the seat, merged with Deqing Harbor to form Anping Harbor, and entered the sea.

sentences.zh: 二層行溪出府治東，茄定港出雁門關嶺，阿公店溪出鳳山縣東北，並西流入于海。

translations.literal: The Ercengxing Stream issued from the east of the prefectural seat; Qieding Harbor issued from Yanmenguan Ridge; Agongdian Stream issued from the northeast of Fengshan County; all flowed west to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Ercengxing Stream rose east of the prefectural seat; Qieding Harbor from Yanmenguan Ridge; and the Agongdian Stream from northeastern Fengshan County—all entered the sea to the west.

sentences.zh: 淡水溪出府治東六張犁，西南流，右納一水，左納二水，經下淡水西，鳳山縣治東，至潮州厝汛北，西冷水溝水出縣東芋匏山，合二水西南流注之。

translations.literal: The Danshui Stream issued from Liuzhangli east of the prefectural seat, flowed southwest, on the right received one stream, on the left received two streams, passed west of Xiadanshui and east of the Fengshan county seat, to north of Chaozhoucuo garrison; the Xilengshuigou Stream issued from Yupao Mountain east of the county, joined two streams and flowed southwest to enter it.
translations.idiomatic: The Danshui Stream rose at Liuzhangli east of the prefectural seat and flowed southwest, receiving one stream on the right and two on the left; passing west of Xiadanshui and east of Fengshan, it reached north of Chaozhoucuo garrison, where the Xilengshuigou Stream from Yupao Mountain joined with two tributaries and entered from the southwest.

sentences.zh: 又西南匯為東港，入於港海。

translations.literal: Again southwest it gathered as Donggang and entered the harbor sea.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest it formed Donggang and entered the coastal waters.

sentences.zh: 茄藤港在鳳山縣南，西流入于海。

translations.literal: Qieteng Harbor was south of Fengshan County and flowed west to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Qieteng Harbor lay south of Fengshan County and flowed west into the sea.

sentences.zh: 率芒溪出恆春縣北武吉山，合一水，西流入于海。

translations.literal: The Shuaimang Stream issued from Wuji Mountain north of Hengchun County, joined one stream, and flowed west to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Shuaimang Stream rose at Wuji Mountain north of Hengchun County, gathered a tributary, and flowed west into the sea.

sentences.zh: 刺桐港、楓港、五重溪、三重港、射寮溪並在恆春縣北，西流入于海。

translations.literal: Citong Harbor, Feng Harbor, Wuzhong Stream, Sanzhong Harbor, and Sheliao Stream were all north of Hengchun County and flowed west to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Citong Harbor, Feng Harbor, the Wuzhong Stream, Sanzhong Harbor, and the Sheliao Stream—all north of Hengchun County—flowed west into the sea.

sentences.zh: 龍鑾潭在恆春縣南，西北流入于海。

translations.literal: Longluantan was south of Hengchun County and flowed northwest to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Longluantan lay south of Hengchun County and drained northwest into the sea.

sentences.zh: 豬勞束港在恆春縣東，東流入于海。

translations.literal: Zhulaoshu Harbor was east of Hengchun County and flowed east to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Zhulaoshu Harbor lay east of Hengchun County and flowed east into the sea.

translations.literal: The Huangxi issued from the southern mountains of the prefectural seat, joined the Shitou Stream, flowed northeast, received one small stream on each side, to Fangqiao Street; the Hongxian Stream joined the waters of the Bajie Stream and others flowing west to enter it.

translations.literal: The Dalongdong Stream issued from Jilong Mountain east of Keelung subprefecture, joined one stream, and flowed west to enter it.
translations.idiomatic: The Dalongdong Stream rose at Jilong Mountain east of Keelung subprefecture, gathered a tributary, and joined from the west.

sentences.zh: 又西北，分流復合，經扈尾港入于海。

translations.literal: Again northwest, dividing and rejoining, it passed Huwei Harbor to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northwest it divided and rejoined, then entered the sea at Huwei Harbor.

sentences.zh: 南崁港上流為大過溪，在府治西北。

translations.literal: The upper reach of Nankan Harbor is the Daguo Stream, northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Nankan Harbor's upper course, the Daguo Stream, lay northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 中瀝溪、土牛溝、紅毛港、鳳山崎溪、舊港、油車港、香山港並在新竹縣西北入于海。

translations.literal: The Zhongli, Tuniugou, Hongmao Harbor, Fengshanqi Stream, Jiugang, Youche Harbor, and Xiangshan Harbor all entered the sea northwest of Xinzhu County.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhongli Stream, Tuniugou, Hongmao Harbor, Fengshanqi Stream, Jiugang, Youche Harbor, and Xiangshan Harbor all entered the sea northwest of Xinzhu County.

sentences.zh: 三貂溪在基隆庁東南，草嶺大溪、加禮遠港、蘇澳門並在宜蘭縣南，俱入于海。

translations.literal: Sandiao Stream was southeast of Keelung subprefecture; Caoling Daxi, Jialiyuan Harbor, and Suao Gate were all south of Yilan County; all entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Sandiao Stream lay southeast of Keelung subprefecture; Caoling Daxi, Jialiyuan Harbor, and Suao Gate—all south of Yilan County—entered the sea.

translations.literal: Taitung Directly Subordinate Prefecture: rated strategically critical, administratively busy, fiscally strained, and geographically difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Taitung Directly Subordinate Prefecture: designated as strategically critical, administratively busy, fiscally strained, and geographically difficult.

translations.literal: Reorganized from Beinan subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It was reorganized from Beinan subprefecture.

translations.literal: Five hundred li northwest of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay five hundred li northwest of the provincial capital.

translations.literal: On the east and south it bordered the sea;
translations.idiomatic: East and south: the sea;

translations.literal: on the west and northwest it bordered Taiwan Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: west and northwest: Taiwan Prefecture;

translations.literal: on the north it bordered Taipei Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: north: Taipei Prefecture;

translations.literal: on the southwest it bordered Tainan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: southwest: Tainan Prefecture.

translations.literal: The figures for width and length in li are missing.
translations.idiomatic: Its dimensions in li are not recorded.

sentences.zh: 北極高二十二度二十五分。

translations.literal: North polar altitude: twenty-two degrees twenty-five minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude is 22°25′ north.

translations.literal: East of the capital by four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: It lies 4° east of the capital meridian.

translations.literal: Beinan: department subprefect stationed.
translations.idiomatic: At Beinan a department subprefect was posted.

translations.literal: Hualian Harbor: department judge stationed.
translations.idiomatic: At Hualian Harbor a department judge was posted.

sentences.zh: 其山在州境者，北：岐來山、能高山。

translations.literal: Mountains within the department: north: Qilai and Nenggao Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains within the department: in the north, Qilai and Nenggao Mountains.

translations.literal: West: Xiuguluan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: West: Xiuguluan Mountain.

translations.literal: East: Dingxiang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: East: Dingxiang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 西出八同關，為秀姑巒山一帶番社，系屬巒番所居。

translations.literal: West of Batong Pass lies the belt of aboriginal villages along Xiuguluan Mountain, belonging to the Luan tribes who dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: West of Batong Pass stretch aboriginal settlements along Xiuguluan Mountain, home to the Luan tribes.

sentences.zh: 西南一帶高山番社，系屬昆番所居。

translations.literal: The belt of high-mountain aboriginal villages in the southwest belongs to the Kun tribes who dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: The highland aboriginal villages of the southwest were home to the Kun tribes.

sentences.zh: 大港上源曰打馬溪，出秀姑巒山，東流經治北，右合網網溪，左合一水，經奇密社北，入于海。

translations.literal: The upper source of Dagang is called the Dama Stream; it issued from Xiuguluan Mountain, flowed east past north of the seat, on the right joined the Wangwang Stream, on the left joined one stream, passed north of Qimi village, and entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Dagang's upper course, the Dama Stream, rose on Xiuguluan Mountain and flowed east past the departmental seat; it received the Wangwang Stream on the right and a tributary on the left, passed north of Qimi village, and entered the sea.

sentences.zh: 卑南大溪出州西南新武洛社，合三水東南流入于海。

translations.literal: The Beinan Daxi issued from Xinwuluo village in the southwest of the department, joined three streams, and flowed southeast to enter the sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Beinan Daxi rose at Xinwuluo village in the department's southwest, gathered three tributaries, and flowed southeast into the sea.

sentences.zh: 花蓮港二源，並出州西北，合數小水，經太平廠南入于海。

translations.literal: Hualian Harbor had two sources, both issuing from the northwest of the department; joining several small streams, it passed south of Taiping station and entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Hualian Harbor rose in two branches from the department's northwest, gathered several tributaries, passed south of Taiping station, and entered the sea.

sentences.zh: 東澳、南澳、大濁水溪、大清水溪、小清水溪、得其黎溪、三棧溪、尤丹溪、米侖港並在州東北，入于海。

translations.literal: Dongao, Nanao, the Dazhuoshui Stream, Daqingshui Stream, Xiaoqingshui Stream, Dedeli Stream, Sanzhan Stream, Youdan Stream, and Milun Harbor were all in the northeast of the department and entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Dongao, Nanao, the Dazhuoshui, Daqingshui, and Xiaoqingshui streams, the Dedeli and Sanzhan streams, the Youdan Stream, and Milun Harbor—all in the department's northeast—entered the sea.

sentences.zh: 紅蝦港、黎仔阬溪、郎阿郎溪、馬武窟溪、八里芒溪、呂家望溪、知本溪、大苗里溪、虷子侖溪、大足高溪、干子壁溪、大烏萬溪、巴塱衛溪、魯木鹿溪、牡丹灣、八磘灣並在州東南，入于海。

translations.literal: Hongxia Harbor, Lizaihang Stream, Langalang Stream, Mawuku Stream, Balimang Stream, Lujiawang Stream, Zhiben Stream, Damiaoli Stream, Haizilun Stream, Dazugao Stream, Ganzi Stream, Dawuwan Stream, Balangwei Stream, Lumulu Stream, Mudan Bay, and Babian Bay were all in the southeast of the department and entered the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxia Harbor, the Lizaihang, Langalang, Mawuku, Balimang, Lujiawang, Zhiben, Damiaoli, Haizilun, Dazugao, Ganzi, Dawuwan, Balangwei, and Lumulu streams, and Mudan and Babian bays—all in the department's southeast—entered the sea.
